hooks.command: "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.claude/hooks/verify.sh" 'lint & unit' 'Run `pnpm lint` and `pnpm test:unit` in this repo. Report whether each passed or failed, and quote any errors with the file and line number.'

"$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.claude/hooks/verify.sh" 'e2e' 'Look at the current diff (`git diff --name-only HEAD`) and run `pnpm test:e2e:ci` for the affected component specs. Report whether they passed or failed, and quote any failing spec with its file and line.'
